post.body: Prices for candy, the most popular Halloween purchase, and gum have risen 7.7% in one year and are up more than 18% in two years, according to the latest federal data.

source.before: For people stocking up on candy this Halloween, it's a spooky season in the grocery store — and not in a fun way.
source.highlight: Prices for candy, the most popular Halloween purchase, and gum have risen 7.7% in one year and are up more than 18% in two years, according to the latest federal data.
source.after: That's higher than the average rate of food inflation during that time.
